Hanging Tag v2

  • Pops out of the pin and hangs on a straight string. No swing.
  • Short address under the name: street · neighbourhood.
  • The tear-off stub is Visited. Two takes below: A punches it, C stamps it.
  • Long notes show in full. No flip-over.

Visited on the stub: A or C?

Opening

While a tag is open, the list drops to its header.

Other places

2 / 3

Card File: Rolodex

The list is a card drawer. Tap a place and its card tips forward to face you, with the card before it standing behind and the rest of the list in front.

Stills

Weak spot. The open drawer is always tall, so the map shrinks for every place, even a name-only one.

3 / 3

Card File: Dealt Out

Tap a place and its card is pulled out of the list and laid on the map under its pin. The list closes up around a thin slot where it goes back, and stays usable.

Stills

Weak spot. It covers the map between the pin and the list, and in a still it looks like a callout; the card-file idea shows mainly in the motion.

Decisions for you

  1. Pick a direction: Tag (A punched or C stamped), Rolodex, or Dealt Out.
  2. Signed out: Directions stays tappable (it changes nothing)? And should tapping a greyed-out Star or Visited offer sign-in?
  3. OK that the list drops to its header while a tag is open?
  4. OK for a district to show a small diamond on the map while its tag is open?
